execution_model.entry: first observed usable exact PumpSwap state at or after signal plus one second
execution_model.exit: first observed usable same-source-instance/epoch/pool state at or after policy horizon
execution_model.fees: exact LP, protocol, and creator fees from the observed transition
execution_model.missed_or_failed: missing exact tape metadata, no post-delay state, quote failure, or no observed exit mark
execution_model.network_and_priority_fees: not present in tape; excluded and must be added before any execution claim
execution_model.price_impact: integer constant-product quote for the fixed notional
execution_model.unobserved_slippage: stress-only 0/25/50 bps token-output haircut; not claimed as measured

hypotheses_only.dynamic_selling: take-profit threshold with observed-state fallback at 300 seconds
hypotheses_only.partial_take_profit: 50% at +100 or +200 bps, residual at the frozen 30-second exit
hypotheses_only.pre_entry_filters: liquidity, prior 30-second net flow, entry fee burden, and their conjunction
hypotheses_only.profit_protection: arm at +100 bps and exit at 0 bps or observed 300-second fallback
hypotheses_only.promotion_rule: no policy is selected from these same-cohort surfaces; any candidate requires a new frozen prospective policy and fresh data

strictness.reported_causal_tier: timestamp+pool fill is coverage-qualified and is not a live-fill proof when the signal signature is absent
strictness.strict_signal_join: target signature must exist in the parity tape
